name: clonamic-korean
description: Write and revise natural Korean documents (resumes, portfolios, reports, posts, docs) with one explicit /clonamic-korean command that keeps facts, numbers, quotes, and the author's voice fixed.

interface.shortDescription: Write or revise natural Korean documents on an explicit command.
interface.longDescription: One command, /clonamic-korean, writes or revises Korean resumes, portfolios, reports, posts, and docs. Natural-language arguments choose light, deep, diagnose, draft, voice, plain, story, or opening work. Facts, numbers, quotes, and names stay fixed.
defaultPrompt: Use Clonamic Korean for this Korean text.
